action_items: URGENT FIX REQUIRED for /app/frontend/src/lib/leaveGuard.js: useBlocker requires a data router. Two viable paths — (A) Migrate App.js from <BrowserRouter> to createBrowserRouter() + <RouterProvider router={...}/>; this also requires moving Routes/Route into a route config object. (B) Replace useBlocker with a manual approach: intercept Link clicks by exposing a NavGuardContext that the top-nav reads, plus history.pushState patching for back/forward, plus the existing beforeunload handler. Option (B) is a smaller change because it avoids restructuring the whole router tree.

After the fix, re-run all Lessons-flow checks: locked-node popover (+ Jump-here button bbox/clickability after mouse move), two-phase pick→check (no green/red on click — only blue ring), check-button reveals correctness (green flash ~900ms then auto-advance / wrong-answer card with lightbulb tip + 'Got it — continue'), pulse-ring -inset-2 scale 1.18 visible OUTSIDE the node, no brut-shadow on non-boss circles, GroupedDots/DotGrid SVG viewBox padding keeps dots inside the dark rounded box.

rca_of_the_issue: The user requested 'ANY navigation away during a lesson should show the Are you sure? modal (used react-router-dom v7 useBlocker)'. Implementation in /app/frontend/src/lib/leaveGuard.js correctly imports and calls useBlocker. However, useBlocker is exclusively a data-router hook — it requires the app to be wrapped in <RouterProvider router={createBrowserRouter(...)}>. /app/frontend/src/App.js still uses <BrowserRouter><Routes>...</Routes></BrowserRouter> (line 58 + 111). When useBlocker is called outside a data router context, React Router throws the invariant 'useBlocker must be used within a data router'. This crashes every component that imports useNavGuard at top level (Lessons, Streak, QuickFire — likely Boss and Daily too). Reproduction: 1) Login as isaacsarver100@gmail.com, 2) Navigate to /lessons → page error overlay 'useBlocker must be used within a data router'. Mitigation choices for the main agent: (a) migrate App.js routing to createBrowserRouter + RouterProvider (recommended — RR v7 already requires this for v7_startTransition future flag and matches modern usage), or (b) rewrite useNavGuard without useBlocker — keep beforeunload, plus a NavGuardContext that the top-nav and any internal navigate() consumers check before calling navigate(). Option (b) is a much smaller change and the chosen migration to data router can come later.
